title: Calendar review
body:
I wish to see the appointment/event in month view thanks.
And more colors for events so you can recognise which event/ task
Thanks
author: Micael29

title: Good but can be made perfect with little effort
body: I wish and really need that instead of the grey dots we ll have a preview or at least coloured dots… It will be very helpful to shift workers who need to plan their overtime duties… So far I need a Google calendar to do that…
author: InTeR_19o8

title: More improvement
body:
I would recommend a line in another color to separate one day from another to make it easier to identify.
And a side button on each different day to give option to include another appointment on that particular day.
Regards 
Chris Piscopo
author: egehth

title: No detailed month view
body: Ideally there should be a mode that allows you seeing all events at a glance for the whole month ( see google calendar) not just a simple dot . ( in that way you won’t need to click on each and every single dot to know what’s the event about )
author: Diste92

title: More flexible options
body:
I’d like to see more flexible options for people who work shifts such as air traffic controllers, doctors, who prefer to write/log down timings to the nearest minute and not 5 minutes. 
Also an option to schedule in travelling time after appointments would be helpful too.
author: marloucal
